precision_policy: Working DEFF1.5 for reported unweighted bases; 2 for reported weighted/unspecified bases;3 for rounded-composition estimates and published suppression lower bounds. Source-informed larger effects override defaults; reported effective bases use DEFF1. Exact source bases retained; fractional model counts floored. These are provisional assumptions, not empirically calibrated guarantees. Reopened sources with missing counts or model-produced subgroup estimates may use an explicit Gaussian covariance:5pp SD per candidate/group share, within-group correlation -0.5; source counts stay null. Proxy inclusion is labeled and separately authorized. Published intervals can use labeled midpoint approximations with half-width-squared added variance.
limitations: Search coverage is documented, not proof every public poll was found. Remaining unreadable, paywalled or incomplete R/D/I sources cannot be invented.
Modeled, mixed or unspecified party classification and source-produced subgroup predictions are included at the user request and labeled distinctly from self-reported ID/registration.
Derived bases, published lower bounds and assumed measurement covariance are modeling choices, not reported interview counts or empirically calibrated error guarantees.
Primary table values are used when narrative summaries conflict, with conflicts retained; interval-censored cells use explicit approximations where recorded.
Publication cutoff remains October1,2026; duplicate wave variants and disclosed fabricated Wedgewood remain excluded.
No forecast accuracy or historical calibration claim follows from a successful replay.
